question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant in the south direction of Art Clinic, New York, NY, limited to 20 kilometers?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography, 20000)
AND amenity = 'fast_food'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
